implementation: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 Kernel Cryptographic API (CFB_C_C)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized CFB AES implementation.
